title: Battery low warning flashing red
shortDescription: Red battery segment flashes when charge drops below ~10%.
fullDescription:
Braun Series 7 and 9 shavers display a red battery segment and beep when capacity is very low. The shaver may still run for 1-3 minutes before shutting down.

Connect the included SmartPlug or place the shaver in the Clean&Charge station. A full charge takes about 1 hour.

fixSteps.title: Plug in charger
fixSteps.instruction: Insert the SmartPlug into the shaver base.

fixSteps.title: Charge 60 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: Leave on charge until all battery bars show solid.

fixSteps.title: Test runtime
fixSteps.instruction: Expect ~50 minutes runtime when new; <10 minutes indicates worn cell.

whenToCallPro: If runtime is under 10 minutes after full charge, the battery needs service.

title: Cleaning icon illuminated
shortDescription: Shower/droplet icon prompts manual or Clean&Charge cleaning.
fullDescription:
The cleaning icon activates after each shave to remind you to rinse the head or insert into the Clean&Charge station. Ignoring it reduces shaving comfort and can trip the hygiene station error.

Rinse under warm water or dock the shaver to cycle automatic cleaning.

fixSteps.title: Rinse head
fixSteps.instruction: Run the shaver under warm water with cap removed for 15 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Or dock to station
fixSteps.instruction: Insert shaver into Clean&Charge station and press CLEAN.

fixSteps.title: Dry completely
fixSteps.instruction: Let the head air-dry before storing.

whenToCallPro: Not applicable — this is a maintenance prompt.

faq.q: How often should I use the station?

title: Clean&Charge station won't start cleaning
shortDescription: Station fault prevents cleaning cycle from starting.
fullDescription:
The Braun Clean&Charge station requires a fresh cartridge, a correctly seated shaver, and AC power to run. Common causes include an empty alcohol cartridge, dried residue on the contacts, or the shaver not fully inserted.

Replace the cartridge and clean the contact strip with a dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in a new Braun CCR cartridge.

fixSteps.title: Wipe contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean the metal contact strip with a dry microfibre.

fixSteps.title: Reseat shaver
fixSteps.instruction: Insert shaver fully until it clicks; press CLEAN.

whenToCallPro: If the station still fails with a new cartridge and clean contacts.

title: Shaver won't start — lock icon showing
shortDescription: Travel lock active — hold power button for 3 seconds to release.
fullDescription:
A padlock icon on the display indicates travel lock is engaged to prevent the shaver turning on in a bag. Hold the power button for about 3 seconds; the padlock animates and clears.

To re-enable, repeat the long press.

fixSteps.title: Hold power 3 seconds
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold until the lock icon blinks and clears.

faq.q: Can the lock be disabled permanently?
faq.a: No, but you can avoid engaging it.

title: Shaving head replacement reminder
shortDescription: Indicator illuminates every 18 months of use.
fullDescription:
Braun recommends replacing the cassette head every 18 months. The reminder is time-based (tracked by charge cycles) and appears as a head/cassette icon on the display.

Install a genuine Braun head (e.g., 73S, 92S) and reset the counter by holding the power button for ~6 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Swap head
fixSteps.instruction: Press release buttons and lift the old cassette; snap the new one in.

fixSteps.title: Reset counter
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button ~6 seconds until the head icon clears.

whenToCallPro: Not needed — head swap is tool-free.

title: Shaver does not charge on plug or station
shortDescription: No battery bars fill — charging circuit, cable, or battery fault.
fullDescription:
If the battery icon shows no activity when plugged in, verify the SmartPlug is fully inserted and the outlet is live. Try charging directly with the cord if using the Clean&Charge station.

Li-ion cells in Series 9 can refuse to charge below 5°C or above 35°C ambient temperature.

fixSteps.title: Try direct cable
fixSteps.instruction: Bypass the station and plug SmartPlug directly into the shaver.

fixSteps.title: Warm to room temp
fixSteps.instruction: Leave shaver at 18-25°C for 30 minutes before charging.

fixSteps.title: Check LED on outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Verify SmartPlug LED lights when connected.

whenToCallPro: If both direct-cable and station fail, battery service is needed.

faq.a: Braun service replaces batteries; DIY voids warranty.

title: Cutter stops under light beard pressure
shortDescription: Motor struggles — hair compaction, lack of lubrication, or weak battery.
fullDescription:
Braun's AutoSense motor should adapt to beard density. If it stalls on light contact, the likely cause is trapped hair under the cassette, dry inner cutter, or a tired battery at end of life.

Clean the head thoroughly and apply a drop of Braun Oil to the inner cutter.

fixSteps.title: Deep clean
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cassette and rinse under hot water; use Clean&Charge if available.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate
fixSteps.instruction: Apply one drop of Braun oil to the inner cutter edge.

fixSteps.title: Full charge test
fixSteps.instruction: Charge to full and test runtime.

whenToCallPro: If stalling persists after cleaning and full charge, battery/motor service.

faq.a: Braun oil or light sewing-machine oil; never WD-40.

title: LCD display shows incorrect segments
shortDescription: Control board or moisture ingress causing display corruption.
fullDescription:
If the display shows nonsense characters, frozen icons, or partial segments, water may have reached the control board, or the firmware has glitched.

Perform a factory reset by removing charge and holding the power button for 30 seconds, then recharge.

fixSteps.title: Drain charge
fixSteps.instruction: Run shaver until it powers off.

fixSteps.title: Long-press reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power for 30 seconds with no charger attached.

whenToCallPro: Persistent display errors after reset indicate board damage.
